mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS trend shows consistent decline over 3 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that prompts central bank rate cuts, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE > 4.0%, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) are rising while industrial production (INDPRO) is falling, it indicates a demand-driven economic expansion with supply constraints, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (RSAFS rising and INDPRO falling) occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth trend (GDPC1) indicates a strengthening economy, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth trend shows consistent quarterly expansion but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where INDPRO < 100.0, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as employment gains boost consumer spending.
failure_condition: In periods of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly, the S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a monetary tightening cycle amid strong labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and UNRATE < 3.5%) occurs but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
